describe.description: The creature is a large composite quadruped standing in right-facing profile on a small patch of dry, sparsely grassed ground. The front half, including the head, neck, chest and two outspread wings, is that of a golden-brown eagle with a hooked beak, yellow eye, and dense layered plumage in shades of gold, tan, cream and dark brown, while the rear half, torso, four legs and long tail are that of a tawny lion with short smooth fur and muscular limbs. The two expansive wings are raised and spread wide above the back, showing detailed flight feathers, and the lion-like tail hangs down behind with a dark tuft at the tip. The overall impression is of a single griffin-like animal combining eagle and lion features in a naturalistic illustration style.
